## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks performed and anything that still needs device testing.
For interface changes, include updated screenshots with demo content.

- [ ] The change follows the brief and design guidelines.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] No private device identifiers, signing material, or machine paths are included.
- [ ] Third-party material has its source and license recorded.
